correctness.rationale: Idempotents are diagonalizable with eigenvalues in {0,1}; pairwise commutation gives a direct sum of joint eigenspaces and the inverse construction is explicit. Orbit-stabilizer yields each summand. The asymptotic follows from balanced block dimensions. Exhaustive small-field checks agree exactly with the formula.

originality.rationale: The inspected Peirce and finite-field idempotent literature gives the structural decomposition and single-idempotent counts, while the full-text Feit–Fine reproof counts unrestricted commuting pairs. None of the inspected material states the arbitrary-tuple joint-eigenspace count or the mod-four probability asymptotic.
residual_risks: The original 1960 Feit–Fine article was not available as full text in this run; its theorem and proof context were checked through a full-text 2018 reproof.

An older source on Boolean subalgebras or simultaneous diagonalization could conceivably contain the same finite-field enumeration under different terminology, although targeted alias searches did not locate one.
